requirements.name: root-joint-pinned
requirements.message: The root joint (the first target of `isaac:physics:robotJoints`) must be pinned for robot types that require a fixed base (e.g. Manipulator, End Effector) and must not be pinned for other robot types.

examples.name: Passing — Manipulator pinned via non-rigid body prim
Passing — End Effector pinned (same rules as Manipulator)
Passing — Mobile robot with root joint **not** pinned
Failing — Manipulator with both bodies rigid (not pinned)
Failing — Mobile robot with a pinned root joint

requirements.name: no-overrides
requirements.message: Robot USDs avoid local override layers that mask upstream schemas or physics.

requirements.name: robot-naming
requirements.message: Canonical robot and prim naming conventions for stable references and tools.

requirements.name: robot-schema
requirements.message: Robot USDs declare and use the required schemas and physics attributes.

requirements.name: verify-robot-physics-attribute-source-layer
requirements.message: Validates that physics attributes are authored in the physics layer.

requirements.name: clean-folder
requirements.message: Robot asset folders contain only referenced, required files. No stray or unused content. At the main level of a robot asset, only the interface layer is present. All other required content is bundled on subfolders related to it specific usage.

requirements.name: verify-robot-physics-schema-source-layer
requirements.message: Validates that physics schema are authored in the physics layer.

requirements.name: thumbnail-exist
requirements.message: The robot interface asset file should contain a thumbnail. The thumbnail should be representative of the robot.

requirements.name: robot-type
requirements.message:
Robot assets must declare a valid robot type on the default prim. The `isaac:robotType` attribute must be present, must be one of the schema-defined allowed tokens, and must not be `"Default"`.
Allowed values are : "End Effector", "Manipulator", "Humanoid", "Wheeled", "Holonomic", "Quadruped", "Mobile Manipulators", "Aerial"
